name: ClipUGC
tagline: Make UGC videos for your app with AI influencers
description: Create an AI influencer from one sentence, generate more looks of the same face, turn them into short clips, and merge a clip with your app screen recording and a hook line into a ready-to-post vertical video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Hosted remote server with OAuth sign-in. Uses ClipUGC credits, with free credits to start.
